verified.narrative: All five source chapters/240 paragraph positions translated; 4,736 English words versus 4,466 Portuguese by recorded tokenizer. Eight personal/place-name occurrence counts agree. Structural correspondence is not semantic fidelity proof.
verified.delivered_formats: English EPUB3: title/language/creator, spine XHTML lang/xml:lang, navigation, distinct URN identity, exact narrative. PDF: 27 A5 pages, exact narrative, correct title, en-US catalog, two embedded Unicode serif faces, complete retained font notices, no JavaScript/encryption. Portuguese delivered formats: 5/240/28 pages still pass.
verified.rebuild: --edition all --out <scratch>/rebuilt; both isolated outputs pass matching narrative/metadata/navigation/font checks. Container IDs/timestamps are not a byte-reproducible contract.

verified.pdf_review: Actual Poppler 1/2/3/19/25 page rasters inspected: title, contents, opening, injury/operation and ending. Three representative raw frames retained; no image editing.

preservation.scope: Every baseline tracked file except the explicit continuity/registry/workflow and P04 producer/checker/readme/provenance updates. Includes all other products, evaluations, original PT creative files and historical sources.

reasoned_assessment.reviewer: Codex is the implementing translator; no independent review. Entire source/translation read and compared, with selected action/dialogue passages re-read alongside their pair.
reasoned_assessment.voices: Baldino keeps defensive admissions, Aevren terse practical/possessive speech, Sava expertise/grief with limited permission, Nera concrete public-water decisions. No heroic absolution, generic moral ending, new resurrection or remote command introduced.
reasoned_assessment.choices: Explicit glossary distinguishes wash valve/ledger, grille/screen, intake/inlet/outlet/drain, brake/beam/loop/counterweight and wrench/key. Resolve me largou pelo casaco against beam re-grasp/no-blow context; shrouding inferred from body preparation. Portuguese remains unchanged; these are translator interpretations, not author ratification.
reasoned_assessment.layout: Inspected serif dialogue/prose, long title/heading fit, linked contents and closing passage; no clipping in sampled PDF pages or horizontal overflow at checked XHTML widths. Not a whole-device usability claim.
